text:
B: Alright! I'm Liam. How you doing?
A: Hiya duck, I'm Stacey! Ooh, love your records. Is that a cat?
B: That's Nacho. He's meant to be the girlfriend's, but he's adopted the decks. Where are you?
A: Sutton-in-Ashfield, near Mansfield. You?
B: Warrington. Funny, the last woman I spoke to were from Warrington too, Great Sankey. I thought they'd done it on purpose.
A: Aw, was that Joanne? I loved her photo, she's got that gin bottle in the background. I said straight away, she's my sort of person.
B: That's her. Dead nice. We spent the whole time talking shop, she's in sales an' all. I'm at a car dealership.
A: Oh, I could tell, you've got that look. I'm a care assistant, in a care home. Older people, mostly dementia.
B: Fair play. I couldn't do that, mate, honestly. That's a proper job.
A: Aw, thank you. It's hard but I love it. The families always ask for me, you know, they want me on when their mum's poorly. You remember all their grandkids' names and that, it means a lot to them.
B: That's the same skill as selling, that. Remembering names. I use everyone's name, me, it works every time, Stacey.
A: Ha, I noticed! See, you're doing it now. I'm dead jealous, though. You must be on good money with commission.
B: Some months, yeah. Sold three on Saturday, top of the board. Other months you're sat there watching the rain.
A: Is that your dog behind you? Oh no, it's the cat again. I've got a French bulldog, Tyson. He's asleep on the settee there, look. He snores like a tractor.
B: He's a unit! Them dogs cost a fortune, don't they?
A: Don't. I got him on finance, if I'm honest. Paying him off monthly like a car. And the vet bills, oh my God.
B: Dog on finance! I've heard it all now. What APR you on?
A: Erm, I don't actually know, lol. Dean sorted half of it. Anyway, what do you do of a weekend?
B: Gigs in Manchester mainly, or I DJ at a bar in town. And I cook, curries, ramen, I wreck the kitchen. Jess goes mad.
A: Dean'd love you. He just does a fakeaway in the air fryer on a Friday. Best thing I ever bought, that air fryer. Do you watch any of the true crime stuff?
B: All of it. I'm on that new documentary series everyone's on about, the one with the husband.
A: Oh my God, I've done the whole thing in two nights! It was him, it was obviously him.
B: Don't tell me, I'm on episode three!
A: Sorry, sorry! My lips are sealed. Did you do alright on the puzzle bit, by the way? I panicked, I thought I'd got it all wrong.
B: I just guessed, mate. Dead easy when you don't care.
A: Ha, I wish I was like that. I was sat there going, they're going to think I'm thick.
B: Nah, nobody's marking it. Where do you go on holiday, then? You look like a Tenerife girl.
A: How did you know! Tenerife or Turkey, all-inclusive. I want Dubai next, just to say I've been, do you know what I mean?
B: I've done Thailand and Vietnam, a month when I was twenty-two. Wanting Japan next but I've done nothing about...
